newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech parl't leaves corporate tax rate at 39 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech parl't leaves corporate tax rate at 39 pct.

text.p: The lower house of the Czech parliament on Friday approved a government proposal to leave the corporate income tax rate at 39 percent in 1997, unchanged from this year.

The Chamber of Deputies rejected an alternative bill submitted by Ivan Masek, of the junior right-wing government coalition party, the Civic Democratic Alliance (ODA), which would have cut the corporate tax rate to 35 percent.
The approved measure excludes income on the sale of securities from capital gains tax if they are held for more than six months. This year the period was three months.
